I love watching movies, talking about movies. And also, recently I started taking up touch rugby, and I have been going on trainings for that lately. And also, I would like to share some of my culture, and also maybe I like making food for others. And if you are into some South Indian cuisine with coconut, I can also share that. Yeah, so, I would be really happy to have a sitting appointment if you... And also, since I am coming from a student apartment, I would be really happy to take up all the furniture which you have mentioned. And I can start from September 1st, and if you need any deposit or amount for the furniture, let me know.


write in german and english;
Dear flat-share seekers,
I'm offering a room with a view of the greenery in a 2-person shared apartment for 7 months.
The room is 20 square meters and contains a bed, table, chair, shelf, side table, and a sofa. You don't have to keep all the furniture if you'd like to bring your own. We can discuss your move-in date. This apartment
is also suitable for commuters.

It has a small kitchen, a small pantry, a cellar, a rear balcony accessible from both your room and mine, and a bathroom with a washing machine. The room and balcony overlook the gardens, and it's quiet.
The rent is €310 plus €60 for utilities, which includes everything: phone/internet, electricity, and heating. The other flatmates are very understanding and interested in a pleasant living environment for everyone.

About me:
I have a positive outlook on life, enjoy sharing my story, and am a good listener. I appreciate a thoughtful effort to understand one another in my fellow human beings, rather than simply living side by side. I was self-employed for a long time, have practical skills, was active in a cooperative grocery store, studied social work and politics, worked in the theater, and most recently in a piano workshop in Oldenburg.
I am open-minded and look forward to engaging in interesting conversations. My favorite hobby for a long time was playing the piano; it always brought me great joy, and I still play occasionally.

That's all for now. I look forward to getting to know you!

Stefan
